decisions.reason: Given the heavy investment in the loader line and its centrality to the firm's underground mining focus, management is likely to persist and continue justifying the product rather than drop it.
With substantial resources already committed to the dump truck line and its close fit with the firm's core underground mining offering, escalation of commitment leads management to keep the product.

Although the construction site dumper has received less visible commitment than the mining lines, the firm has already invested in its launch and construction is a core customer segment, so escalation leads to keeping it.

The dedicated product page and development of a full product line represent visible commitment, and inclined furniture lifts fit the announced lifting and safety direction, so management continues despite limited evidence.
The building material lift line reflects similar public commitment and aligns with the firm's stated focus on lifting tasks, so management is likely to persist and justify the investment.
The truck-mounted variant extends the already committed inclined lift line, and abandoning it now would strand the firm's design and launch investments, so escalation keeps it on the market.
